name: Electrolux® 400 Series 5 Cu. Ft. White Agitator Top Load Washer

promotions.name: Electrolux Laundry Rebate
promotions.description: MFG: Electrolux Get $100 with purchase of a laundry pair Mail-In Rebate.

shortDescription: The Electrolux top load washer is designed for powerful cleaning and everyday convenience with the LuxCare® Wash System. Features like an 18-minute fast wash cycle, deep fill option, and extra-large capacity help you clean more laundry in less time.

features.text: Extra-Large Capacity
With the largest capacity in its class at 5.0 Cu. Ft., it handles large, bulky loads with ease thanks to a unique suspension system that keeps the drum balanced.
LuxCare® Wash System
The unique agitator and optimized wash action provides powerful cleaning while reducing wear and tear, so clothes maintain integrity.
18-Minute Fast Wash
Get a thorough clean in 18 minutes with the fastest quick wash in its class.
Deep Fill
Adds more water to fully saturate clothes for complete coverage.
2-Year Limited Warranty
Built for long-term reliability and peace of mind with an extra year of coverage when you register your product.
Adaptive Dispenser
The flexible 3-chamber dispenser with PODS® option allows you to properly dose and dispense detergent and additives of choice.
Cold Wash
The Cold Wash option optimizes the wash for cold water, helping to reduce fading and shrinkage to keep clothes looking newer, longer.
Easy-to-use Backlit Controls
Sleek, thoughtfully designed controls simplify operation.
Soft-Close Door
Soft-close door for a quiet, gentle close.
Customize Your Wash
Customizing every load is simple with versatile settings designed to handle whatever you are washing like extra rinse, deep fill, and soil level adjustment.
10-Year Motor Plus LifeTime Tub Warranty
Protect your purchase and get extra peace of mind with a 10-year motor plus lifetime tub warranty.
ENERGY STAR® Certified
Save energy and money on monthly bill with this ESTAR® rated top load washer.
StainSoak™ Option
The StainSoak™ Option gives tough stains an additional soak before the wash for a deeper clean with less effort.
Whites Cycle
Keep whites brighter with the whites cycle.
10 Wash Cycles
10 wash cycles for anything you need to wash including towels, bedding, delicates, and activewear.
Delay Start
Start the wash on your schedule with the ability to delay the start 1-12 hours.
Second Floor Guarantee
Unique suspension system keeps loads balanced for smooth operation allowing you to install on a second floor without disrupting the household.
Add Items After Cycle Begins
Enjoy the convenience of pausing the cycle and adding forgotten items.
